away.name: Yaroslav Askarov
away.news: While the Sharks have struggled, going 1-4-0 in their last five, Askarov has showcased some of his best netminding with the team. The 24-year-old Russian goalie saved 20 of 22 shots (.909 SV%) in his most recent game, a 2-1 loss to the Calgary Flames. He has saved 152 of 161 shots (.944 SV%) in his last five outings (2-3-0). The Sharks enter Wednesday's game as +147 road underdogs against a Los Angeles Kings team coming off a 3-2 loss to the Buffalo Sabres.

home.name: Darcy Kuemper
home.news: Kuemper has had an inconsistent start to the 2026-27 season, but remains the only Kings goalie with a win and returns to the crease Wednesday. The 36-year-old goalie struggled in his most recent outing, allowing five goals on 22 shots (.773 SV%), but salvaged a 6-5 overtime win over the Ottawa Senators, extending his winning streak to four games. In eight games this season (4-3-1), Kuemper has a 3.65 GAA and .878 SV%. The Kings enter Wednesday's outing as -163 home favourites against a struggling San Jose Sharks team that has scored only five combined goals in its past four games (1-3-0).

away.name: Dustin Wolf
away.news: With Devin Cooley (lower body) still sidelined, the Flames will continue to lean on Wolf. Wolf had an impressive rookie season in 2024-25, finishing runner-up for the Calder Trophy, but has struggled since. That said, he has strung together some better outings lately, posting a 3.00 GAA and .892 SV% in his last five games. The Flames enter Wednesday's game as +116 road underdogs against a Seattle Kraken team that hasn't played since losing 6-2 to the Flames on October 30th.

home.name: Joey Daccord
home.news: Daccord hasn't played much lately, often taking a backseat to Philipp Grubauer, but he will return to the crease on Wednesday. The 30-year-old Grubauer struggled in his last start, allowing four goals on 35 shots (.886 SV%) in a 5-1 loss to the Minnesota Wild. He has an ugly 3.96 GAA and .880 SV% in seven appearances this season (3-3-0). The Kraken enter Wednesday's game as -128 home favourites against a Calgary Flames team that defeated them 6-2 less than a week ago.
